about_the_game:
Project Colored Mountains is a cozy and colorful 3D platformer starring a bouncy little robot on a lighthearted adventure through strange and playful environments.

Jump, stretch, and roll through calm and fun spaces like quiet schools, empty water parks, and other unexpected places. Along the way, you'll unlock new abilities and discover what all those blocks actually do.

You can bounce in midair, stretch your body like rubber, and launch yourself across rooms in ways that would never work in real life. Every area is built to reward curiosity, letting you experiment and figure things out at your own pace.

Features:

  • Smooth, satisfying platforming

  • Explore a variety of bright, colorful levels full of secrets

  • Unlock new movement abilities as you go

  • Find hidden entrances and secret levels

  • Interact with all kinds of strange blocks, just to see what happens

Ideal for players who enjoy upbeat platformers, creative movement, and exploring just to see what you might find.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or similar Debian-based distro; SteamOS 3 or similar Arch or Arch-based distro
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 3000 series or later, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 or later, or equivalent; requires Vulkan support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ or similar Debian-based distro; SteamOS 3 or similar Arch or Arch-based distro
  • Processor: Ryzen 5/7 3000 series or later, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 or later, or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Have 5-7 GB of free storage space available if purchasing in Early Access, as the game's file size will grow significantly

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th generation) or M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Project Colored Mountains has only been tested on Apple Silicon processors, Intel ones may not work.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11+
  • Processor: Any M-series chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Have 7-9 GB of free space if purchasing in Early Access, as the game's file size will grow significantly
